ImageDescription.value: The West Annex Hall of the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests in the Temple of Heaven, Dongcheng, Beijing, 22 April 2020. The Temple of Heaven was a complex of buildings and gardens built by the Ming Dynasty in 1406-20, extended in the 16th Century and renovated in the 18th Century, In the 1900 Boxer Rebellion the Eight Nations Alliance made it their HQ, which resulted in much damage by the occupiers. Subsequently, the complex fell into considerable disrepair and dilapidation. In 1918 it was made into a public park by the Republic and eventually restored.
